description: This file defines a class `DelegateAsyncTimer` implementing the `IAsyncTimer` interface, providing a delegate-based timer mechanism for asynchronous operations in tests.

classes.name: DelegateAsyncTimer
classes.description: A delegate-based implementation of IAsyncTimer for testing asynchronous timer behavior.

methods.name: DelegateAsyncTimer
methods.description: Constructor accepting a delegate to determine the next tick behavior.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to get the next timer tick, optionally with an override delay.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the timer, always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Increments the disposal counter, indicating the timer has been disposed.
